correctness.rationale: Specializing the stated FFP2 recurrence to \(T=0\) and \(G(x)=\lambda x\) gives the inspected scalar two-state recurrence. The package's source-bound replay uses \(t_0\ge\max\{r,((r-1)(2r-1)\eta)/((r-1)\eta-\nu),(r-1)/(r+1)\}\), so the proof's \(t_k\ge r\) requirement is satisfied. Positivity and \(0<q_k=x_k/z_k\le1\) follow inductively. The stable comparison \(q_{k+1}\le\theta q_k+\theta r/t_k\), \(\theta=(1-a)/(1-c)<1\), gives \(q_k=O(t_k^{-1})\). For \(p_k=t_kq_k\), the exact recurrence has \(p_{k+1}=(1-a)(p_k+r)+o(1)\), hence \(p_k\to r(1-a)/a\) and \(t_kh_k\to r/a\). The product update for \(z_k\) then has decrements \(\delta_k=s/t_k+o(t_k^{-1})\) with summable squared errors, yielding \(\log z_k=-s\log k+o(\log k)\), and therefore the two claimed iterate exponents and kth-root limit.
